storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP PornHub Downloader makes it easy to save videos from Pornhub.com to your computer.

How it works: Go to any video page on Pornhub, press play, and either click the download button on the player or the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension extracts the video stream from Pornhub's flashvars and mediaDefinitions, shows available quality options, and downloads it as a standard MP4 file.

It handles HLS streaming, flashvars extraction, /video/get_media API calls, and M3U8 playlist parsing automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized PornHub subfolder.

Key features:
- Automatic video detection via flashvars and mediaDefinitions extraction
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Real-time download progress with speed indicators
- Right-click context menu for quick downloads
- Desktop notifications when downloads complete
- Dark-themed UI with Pornhub orange accents
- Works on Pornhub, Pornhub Premium, and Thumbzilla
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to Pornhub.com and play a video
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and download — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video?
faq.answer: Go to any video page on Pornhub.com and press play. Then click the download button on the player, click the extension icon, or right-click and select "Download PornHub Video."

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from Pornhub's mediaDefinitions — typically multiple resolutions up to the highest available. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first), with MP4 preferred over HLS.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to a PornHub subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: Does this work on Pornhub Premium?
faq.answer: Yes — the extension works on Pornhub, Pornhub Premium, and Thumbzilla.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Press play on the video first. The extension needs the stream to start before detection works. If issues persist, refresh the page and try again.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
